title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 22
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 22: Ahaziah's short reign, Jehu's judgment, and Athaliah's seizing of power.

questions.text: Why did the inhabitants of Jerusalem make Ahaziah, the youngest son, king?
questions.explanation: They made him king because the band of men who came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the oldest.

answers.text: The men with the Arabians had slain all the oldest
His older brothers had all refused the throne
The prophet Elijah had chosen and anointed him
He had won a great battle against Edom

questions.text: How long did Ahaziah reign in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Ahaziah was forty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem.
His mother's name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.

questions.text: Against whom did Ahaziah go to war with Jehoram the son of Ahab?
questions.explanation: Ahaziah went with Jehoram the son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead.

questions.text: Where did Joram return to be healed of his wounds?
questions.explanation: The Syrians wounded Joram, and he returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds they had given him at Ramah.

questions.text: Whom had Yahweh anointed to cut off Ahab's house?
questions.explanation: Jehoram and Ahaziah went out against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom Yahweh had anointed to cut off Ahab's house.

questions.text: Where was Ahaziah hiding when he was caught?
questions.explanation: They sought Ahaziah and caught him while he was hiding in Samaria, and brought him to Jehu.

answers.text: In a cave at En Gedi

questions.text: What did Athaliah do when she saw that her son was dead?
questions.explanation: Athaliah arose and destroyed all the royal offspring of the house of Judah.

answers.text: She fled to her father's house in Samaria
She tore her clothes and mourned for seven days
She destroyed all the royal offspring of the house of Judah
She sent gifts of silver and gold to Jehu

questions.text: Who rescued Joash the son of Ahaziah and hid him from Athaliah?
questions.explanation: Jehoshabeath, the king's daughter and the wife of Jehoiada the priest, took Joash and hid him from Athaliah.

questions.text: Where was Joash hidden for six years while Athaliah reigned?
questions.explanation: He was with them hidden in God's house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.
